items.title: 高生產力、耐用、具通用性：輝達 AI 工廠如何最大化投資報酬率 / Productive, Durable, Fungible: How NVIDIA AI Factories Maximize Return on Investment

sources.title: 高生產力、耐用、具通用性：輝達 AI 工廠如何最大化投資報酬率 / Productive, Durable, Fungible: How NVIDIA AI Factories Maximize Return on Investment
sources.title_zh: 高生產力、耐用、具通用性：輝達 AI 工廠如何最大化投資報酬率
sources.title_en: Productive, Durable, Fungible: How NVIDIA AI Factories Maximize Return on Investment
sources.title_original: Productive, Durable, Fungible: How NVIDIA AI Factories Maximize Return on Investment
sources.summary: AI factories are built by the megawatt, even by the gigawatt. Each megawatt factory costs roughly $60 million, and AI factory operators will only commit capital on that scale with a clear view of the return on investment. Three key things shape AI factory returns: Earning capacity: What the factory could earn in a year […]
sources.summary_zh: AI 工廠的建設規模以百萬瓦（megawatt）計，甚至達到十億瓦（gigawatt）。每座百萬瓦等級的工廠成本大約高達 6000 萬美元，而 AI 工廠營運商只有在清楚看到投資報酬率的情況下，才會投入如此規模的資金。影響 AI 工廠投資報酬率的三個關鍵要素為：獲利能力：工廠一年內可能賺取的收益 […]

items.title: 醫療保險業者將矛頭指向人工智慧，因出現近 10 億美元的可疑醫院費用 / Health insurer points finger at AI as nearly $1 billion in questionable hospital charges appear

sources.title: 醫療保險業者將矛頭指向人工智慧，因出現近 10 億美元的可疑醫院費用 / Health insurer points finger at AI as nearly $1 billion in questionable hospital charges appear
sources.title_zh: 醫療保險業者將矛頭指向人工智慧，因出現近 10 億美元的可疑醫院費用
sources.title_en: Health insurer points finger at AI as nearly $1 billion in questionable hospital charges appear
sources.title_original: Health insurer points finger at AI as nearly $1 billion in questionable hospital charges appear
sources.summary: As AI codes billing inside hospitals, insurers say costs are added to a bloated health care system. Blue Cross Blue Shield put the tab as high as $1 billion.
sources.summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧在醫院內部編碼帳單，保險業者表示成本被加進了龐大的醫療體系中。Blue Cross Blue Shield 估計這筆帳單高達 10 億美元。
